en.description: Self-hosted MySQL CMS/backend with a built-in MCP endpoint for permission-scoped schema discovery and collection data reads, plus opt-in create, update, and delete operations. Its 7 MCP tools share YunCMS RBAC; the endpoint is disabled and read-only by default, and Administrators can separately opt into its three write tools. Install: `npx --yes @yunsoft/yuncms init`, then `npx --yes @yunsoft/yuncms start`. Transport: streamable HTTP at `POST /mcp`; auth: bearer session or API token by default. Node.js 24, MySQL 8, MIT. Website: https://yunsoft.com. Docs: https://github.com/Yunsoft-Software/yuncms/blob/main/docs/mcp.md.
